Jones Collombin Investment Counsel Decreased Position in Groupe Cgi (GIB) by $3.06 Million; As Apple (AAPL) Stock Rose, Holder Manchester Capital Management Has Lifted Its Stake
June 29, 2018 - By Marguerite Chambers
Jones Collombin Investment Counsel Inc decreased its stake in Groupe Cgi Inc (GIB) by 39.07% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Jones Collombin Investment Counsel Inc sold 53,694 shares as the company’s stock rose 3.48% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 83,726 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $4.83 million, down from 137,420 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Jones Collombin Investment Counsel Inc who had been investing in Groupe Cgi Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $17.93 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.64% or $1.01 during the last trading session, reaching $62.74. About 200,525 shares traded or 5.98% up from the average. CGI Group Inc. (NYSE:GIB) has risen 23.22% since June 29, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 10.65% the S&P500. Manchester Capital Management Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 18.36% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Manchester Capital Management Llc bought 9,871 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 63,629 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $10.68M, up from 53,758 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Manchester Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $911.76 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.73% or $1.34 during the last trading session, reaching $185.5. About 15.74M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 29, 2017 and is uptrending.
